metadata.display_name: Gemini Omni Flash 1.2 Text to Video
metadata.description: Gemini Omni Flash 1.2 is Google's multimodal video model. This endpoint generates video with synchronized native audio from a text prompt, at 360p, 720p, 1080p, or 4K, in 16:9 or 9:16, with durations from 3 to 15 seconds.

Gemini Omni Flash 1.2 is Google's multimodal video model. This endpoint continues an existing video from a text prompt, conditioning on its last 10 seconds and appending a new 3 to 10 second segment. Output resolution is selectable from 360p, 720p, 1080p, or 4K.
Turn one product photo into a seamless 5 to 15 second video loop with a locked camera, subtle ambient motion or a full 360° spin.

metadata.display_name: Gemini Omni Flash 1.2 Image to Video
metadata.description: Gemini Omni Flash 1.2 is Google's multimodal video model. This endpoint animates a start image into video with synchronized native audio, with an optional end image for first-to-last-frame interpolation of up to 10 seconds. Output is available at 360p, 720p, 1080p, or 4K, with durations from 3 to 15 seconds.

metadata.display_name: Gemini Omni Flash 1.2 Reference to Video
metadata.description: Gemini Omni Flash 1.2 is Google's multimodal video model. This endpoint generates video from a text prompt combined with up to ten reference images and up to three reference videos, each addressable in the prompt, using them as visual references for subjects and settings. Output is available at 360p, 720p, 1080p, or 4K, with durations from 3 to 15 seconds.

Gemini Omni Flash 1.2 is Google's multimodal video model. This endpoint edits an existing video of up to 15 seconds from a natural-language instruction, applying the requested change while keeping the rest of the scene unchanged. Output resolution is selectable from 360p, 720p, 1080p, or 4K.
